senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; ירש Ges.; cmp., however, רָשַׁשׁ)juice, must, wine.
units: Tosef. Ned. IV, 3 הנודר מן הת׳ … ומותר ביין he that vows abstinence from tirosh is forbidden all kinds of sweet juice, but is permitted (fermented) wine; Y. ib. VII, 40ᵇ bot. כמאן דאמר … התורה קראת אותו ת׳ תִּירוֹשְׁךָ זה היין this is according to him who says, that in vows we follow the ordinary usage, but according to him who says that we must be guided by Biblical usage, the Bible calls it (wine) tirosh; ‘thy tirosh’ (Deut. XI, 14) means wine; (quot. from) Sifré Deut. 42.

<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 42:10">Ib.</cite> <he>תרושך מלא</he> (read <he>תיר׳</he>) ‘thy wine’, that means in abundance. Pesik. ‘Asser, p. 100ᵃ (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 14:22">Deut. XIV, 22</cite>, a.

<cite ref="Hosea 2:11">Hos. II, 11</cite>) <he>אם זכיתם תירושך ואם לאו תִּירוֹשִׁי</he> if you do good, it is thb must, if not, it is my must; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 897:1">Yalk. Deut. 897</cite>; a. e.
